test_case.test_name: Parameterized M.2 random-read512B QD1 sustained working-set validation
test_case.purpose: Measure sustained random-read IOPS, bandwidth and latency over the approved M.2 working set while verifying random distribution, cache policy, thermal/link stability and project limits.
required_package: M.2 serial/firmware/namespace/path plus explicit offset/size random working set
PCIe/controller, filesystem/raw, cache/read-ahead/power and preconditioning profile
Approved fio/libaio artifact and exact hashed job
Full43200-second authorization with thermal/SMART/media/AER abort limits
Versioned random-read IOPS/BW/latency thresholds and repetition/tolerance policy
test_case.test_command: Capture namespace/path, root-port, mounts/RAID/LVM, cache/read-ahead/power and health baseline; prove read-safe non-OS target; bind offset/size and preconditioning; validate pinned fio and exact randread/512B/iodepth1/numjobs1/norandommap/randrepeat/refill_buffers/10s-ramp/43200s job; run once with full structured output, distribution/range evidence and continuous health telemetry.
test_case.expected_result: The approved random working set is exercised for the full duration with zero writes/errors, expected distribution, no disallowed cache/throttle/link artifact and every approved random-read performance threshold met.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/range/profile, achieved full duration and distribution, complete evidence, zero writes/errors, healthy M.2/PCIe state and all thresholds. Missing range/threshold, shortened run or cache-induced invalidity is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Exclude OS, mounted valuable data and active RAID/LVM members.
Confirm serial/namespace/path, bounded read range and version-specific overwrite semantics.
Abort on write indication, SMART/media/AER error, link downgrade or thermal limit.
No60-second substitution, filtered output or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: M.2 identity, namespace/range and root-port map
fio artifact, exact job, full output and working-set/distribution evidence
Random-read threshold matrix and final health
test_case.recovery: On path/range mismatch, write indication, health error or invalid cache state, stop without retry, preserve evidence, restore temporary settings and verify namespace, link and device/host health.
